Ngome ya mtandao: Kikomo cha kasi dhidi ya kunakili

Firewall: The registration could not be completed.
This password appears in known data breaches, so attackers try it first. Please choose another one.
Ngome ya mtandao: Nenosiri hili linaonekana katika uvujaji wa data unaojulikana, kwa hivyo washambulizi hulijaribu kwanza. Tafadhali chagua jingine.

Firewall: Only when the whole shop works on HTTPS and will keep working: browsers remember it and refuse plain HTTP until it expires.
Ngome ya mtandao: Tu ikiwa duka zima linafanya kazi kwa HTTPS na litaendelea hivyo: vivinjari hukumbuka hilo na hukataa HTTP ya kawaida hadi muda uishe.

Firewall: Thank you. The owner of the shop will look at it and, if it was a mistake, let you through.
Ngome ya mtandao: Asante. Mmiliki wa duka ataliangalia na, ikiwa lilikuwa kosa, atakuruhusu kupita.

Firewall: This request was stopped for security reasons. If you think this is a mistake, tell the owner of the shop what you were doing:
Ngome ya mtandao: Ombi hili limezuiwa kwa sababu za usalama. Ikiwa unadhani ni kosa, mweleze mmiliki wa duka ulichokuwa ukifanya:

Firewall: Force HTTPS in browsers for 6 months (HSTS)
Ngome ya mtandao: Lazimisha HTTPS kwenye vivinjari kwa miezi 6 (HSTS)

Firewall: The password must have at least %1 characters.
Ngome ya mtandao: Nenosiri lazima liwe na angalau herufi %1.

Firewall: [%1] Someone asks you to review a firewall block
Ngome ya mtandao: [%1] Mtu anakuomba ukague kizuizi cha ngome

Firewall: A visitor stopped by the firewall asks for a review. To let them through or not: bin/magento draco:reviews
Ngome ya mtandao: Mgeni aliyezuiwa na ngome anaomba ukaguzi. Kumruhusu apite au la: bin/magento draco:reviews
Kiotomatiki: majaribio %1 ya roboti ndani ya saa 24
Hakuna kiwango cha chini (sheria za Magento pekee)
Ruhusu nchi zilizo kwenye orodha pekee

Firewall: Stops requests with the shape of an attack (database injection, reading server files, running code, scripts in links) and the scanners that look for weak spots. The admin panel is never inspected. Start with "Log only" for a few days. Emergency exit: 'draco_waf_off' => true in app/etc/env.php. Try it: bin/magento draco:test
Ngome ya mtandao: Inazuia maombi yenye umbo la shambulio (kuingiza kwenye hifadhidata, kusoma faili za seva, kuendesha msimbo, hati kwenye viungo) na vichanganuzi vinavyotafuta udhaifu. Paneli ya msimamizi haikaguliwi kamwe. Anza kwa siku chache na "Rekodi tu". Njia ya dharura: 'draco_waf_off' => true kwenye app/etc/env.php. Ijaribu: bin/magento draco:test

Firewall: Too many pages a minute from one address or one network get "429, come back in a minute". Customers who are logged in and search engines verified by DNS are never limited.
Ngome ya mtandao: Kurasa nyingi mno kwa dakika kutoka anwani moja au mtandao mmoja hupata "429, rudi baada ya dakika moja". Wateja walioingia na injini za utafutaji zilizothibitishwa kwa DNS hawazuiliwi kamwe.
Kurasa kwa dakika kwa kila anwani
Kurasa kwa dakika kwa kila mtandao
Ngao dhidi ya roboti kwenye usajili wa wateja

Firewall: Adds an invisible trap and a signed page stamp to the "Create an Account" form, without captchas. Bots get no account; three bot attempts in one day block the address for a week.
Ngome ya mtandao: Huongeza mtego usioonekana na muhuri wa ukurasa uliotiwa saini kwenye fomu ya "Fungua Akaunti", bila captcha. Roboti hazipati akaunti; majaribio matatu ya roboti kwa siku moja huzuia anwani kwa wiki moja.

Firewall: Refuse or allow visitors by country, from a public list (DB-IP Lite, CC BY 4.0) downloaded once a month by cron and looked up locally. Behind Cloudflare its own country header is used.
Ngome ya mtandao: Kataa au ruhusu wageni kulingana na nchi, kutoka orodha ya umma (DB-IP Lite, CC BY 4.0) ambayo cron hupakua mara moja kwa mwezi na kuitafuta ndani. Nyuma ya Cloudflare, kichwa chake cha nchi hutumika.

Firewall: Two-letter codes separated by commas, such as RU, CN.
Ngome ya mtandao: Misimbo ya herufi mbili iliyotenganishwa kwa koma, kama RU, CN.

Firewall: Only change the header when the shop is behind that proxy. A header from any other connection is ignored, so nobody can pose as another address.
Ngome ya mtandao: Badilisha kichwa ikiwa tu duka liko nyuma ya proksi hiyo. Kichwa kutoka muunganisho mwingine wowote hupuuzwa, kwa hivyo hakuna anayeweza kujifanya kuwa anwani nyingine.

Firewall: Addresses or CIDR ranges, separated by commas. Empty: this machine and private networks. Cloudflare's ranges are already known.
Ngome ya mtandao: Anwani au masafa ya CIDR, yaliyotenganishwa kwa koma. Tupu: mashine hii na mitandao ya faragha. Masafa ya Cloudflare yanajulikana tayari.

Firewall: CIDR ranges, one per line, added to the ones Draco knows.
Ngome ya mtandao: Masafa ya CIDR, moja kwa kila mstari, yanayoongezwa kwa yale ambayo Draco inajua.
Anwani ambazo hazizuiwi wala kuwekewa kikomo kamwe

Firewall: Separated by commas, on top of the last addresses administrators logged in from.
Ngome ya mtandao: Zimetenganishwa kwa koma, juu ya anwani za mwisho ambazo wasimamizi waliingia kutoka.

Firewall: Start of the path, one per line, such as webhooks that receive signed payloads.
Ngome ya mtandao: Mwanzo wa njia, moja kwa kila mstari, kama webhook zinazopokea data iliyotiwa saini.

Firewall: nosniff, SAMEORIGIN, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy. Draco never replaces a header the shop already sends.
Ngome ya mtandao: nosniff, SAMEORIGIN, Referrer-Policy na Permissions-Policy. Draco haibadilishi kamwe kichwa ambacho duka linatuma tayari.

Firewall: Applied when a customer chooses a password: sign-up, account page, reset link and the API. Existing passwords keep working.
Ngome ya mtandao: Hutumika mteja anapochagua nenosiri: usajili, ukurasa wa akaunti, kiungo cha kuweka upya na API. Manenosiri yaliyopo yanaendelea kufanya kazi.

Firewall: Refuse passwords that appear in known data breaches
Ngome ya mtandao: Kataa manenosiri yanayoonekana katika uvujaji wa data unaojulikana

Firewall: Asks Have I Been Pwned with only the first 5 characters of the password's SHA-1: the password never leaves your server. If the service does not answer in 3 seconds, the password is accepted.
Ngome ya mtandao: Huuliza Have I Been Pwned kwa herufi 5 za kwanza tu za SHA-1 ya nenosiri: nenosiri haliondoki kamwe kwenye seva yako. Huduma isipojibu ndani ya sekunde 3, nenosiri linakubaliwa.

Firewall: Visitors stopped by the firewall can ask for a review from the block page. You get at most one e-mail an hour; decide with bin/magento draco:reviews.
Ngome ya mtandao: Wageni waliozuiwa na ngome wanaweza kuomba ukaguzi kutoka ukurasa wa kizuizi. Unapokea barua pepe moja kwa saa kwa zaidi; amua kwa bin/magento draco:reviews.

Firewall: Empty: the store's general contact e-mail.
Ngome ya mtandao: Tupu: barua pepe ya mawasiliano ya jumla ya duka.
